{{Quote|I am Ferroda, the Jedi Master in charge of this battalion.|Ferroda, to X2|<ref name="SWBES" />}}
'''Ferroda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was killed during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[X2]] on the planet of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].

==Biography==
[[File:X2_challenges_Ferroda.jpg|thumb|left|200px|X2 takes a stand to defend X1 from Ferroda during Order 66.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Ferroda was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] after constructing a green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Master Ferroda took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was assigned to oversee the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] garrisoned on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Overseeing the training on the desert world, Ferroda became acquainted with the twin Force-sensitive clones [[X1]] and [[X2]] when Tatooine was attacked by the Separatists. The clones were successful in defeating the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] of the Separatists, repelling the Separatist leadership and securing the world by the end of the [[Invasion of Tatooine|battle]].<ref name="SWBES" />

As the war toiled on, Master Ferroda was reassigned to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] where he was under the command of [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council member]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. During the fighting, Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], revealed to be a Sith Lord, began eradicating the Jedi by initiating [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] Order 66, turning the clones against the Jedi. Ambushed during the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|fighting]], Ferroda encountered X1 and X2 once again. X1 attempted to kill Ferroda but was injured by his lightsaber. X2 grew angry at Ferroda and tried to kill him, trapping the blue-skinned Jedi in a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] building and executing him.<ref name="SWBES" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|You just killed most of our platoon!''"<br />"''I had no choice!''"<br />"''Neither do I| Ferroda and X2 before X2 kills the Jedi|<ref name="SWBES" />}}
After Master Ferroda's death his executioner, X2, regretted his decision of following orders and disavowed his ties with the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Laying low for a time, X2 eventually joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] after he was found on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] by General [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]].<ref name="SWBES" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Ferroda was originally created for the cancelled ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront III]]'' from [[Free Radical Design]]. He would instead go on to be used in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''. His species is never stated in the game, though with blue skin and yellow markings he remarkably resembles the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] (specifically [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]]) this was also confirmed in 2021, when Rich May (Rebellion Developments' lead programmer in the development of ''Elite Squadron'') stated that they didn't had an official word about it (his race), but that the original textures certainly had the yellow markings distinctive of a Pantoran.
